newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money market rates flat on high supply.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money market rates flat on high supply.

text.p: Croatian money market rates remained unchanged on Wednesday amid improved supply of kuna funds, dealers said.
"The kuna on offer today has overshot demand by some 55 million kuna," a dealer told Reuters.
She said dealers managed to persuade banks to close extra deals in order to get the market going.
Fresh trade totalled 27.2 million kuna of which 24 million were call money loans granted at an unchanged 10.5 percent.
A six-day interbank term loan was also granted at 10.5 percent.
Savings banks were granted one-month loans at 16, 17 and 18 percent.
Tuesday's overnight trade totalled three million kuna sought by one savings bank to maintain its mandatory reserve. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
